Standard: In any axis or in a combination of axes, there is no tendency for sustained or uncontrollable unintentional oscillations in which the air vehicle attitude, angular rate, acceleration, or other quantity derived from these states is approximately 180 degrees out of phase with the pilot or control system's commands. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the hover and low airspeed bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) and Short-term Response to Yaw Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Similarly, conduct analysis to assess the forward flight bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response (Bandwidth), Small Amplitude Roll Attitude Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs. Analyze time domain data of inceptor activity and air vehicle response as well as qualitative pilot comments and PIO ratings (as required) that result from the execution of MTEs for PIO tendency. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the hover and low airspeed bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) and Short-term Response to Yaw Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Similarly, conduct analysis to assess the forward flight bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response (Bandwidth), Small Amplitude Roll Attitude Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs. Analyze time domain data of inceptor activity and air vehicle response as well as qualitative pilot comments and PIO ratings (as required) that result from the execution of MTEs for PIO tendency. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the hover and low airspeed bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) and Short-term Response to Yaw Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Similarly, conduct analysis to assess the forward flight bandwidth criterion as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Short-term Response (Bandwidth), Small Amplitude Roll Attitude Response to Control Inputs (Bandwidth) paragraphs. Analyze time domain data of inceptor activity and air vehicle response as well as qualitative pilot comments and PIO ratings (as required) that result from the execution of MTEs for PIO tendency.
